fieldValues.title: ext:discovery conformance requires passing structured-filter fixture scenarios
fieldValues.normative_statement: An implementation that declares `ext:discovery` MUST pass all structured-filter conformance scenarios (`exactMatch: true`) from the fixture at `srs/conformance/discovery/scenarios.json`, returning exactly the `expectedInstanceIds` set for each such scenario. When a scenario also carries an `expectedSegments` expectation, the implementation's Text Projection for the named field of the named instance MUST additionally match the expected segment sequence exactly in count and order — testing I-120's list-cardinality rule ("one segment per array element in order") that `expectedInstanceIds` alone cannot express. (RFC-012 R11; srs#483.)
